name: afc
description: Away from Claude (AFC): tools to develop while away from the PC. AFK mode (keeps the PC awake, safe auto-permissions), a work queue planned with you and run while you are away, auto-resume when a usage limit resets, Remote Control toggle and push notifications for the events you choose, an on-demand return report; side panel with status, countdown, limit bars and stats

afkAmmessi.title: AFK: extra allowed commands
afkAmmessi.description: Command prefixes Claude may run without asking while AFK mode is on, comma-separated (e.g. 'docker compose up, ./scripts/check.sh')

afkNegati.title: AFK: extra denied commands
afkNegati.description: Command prefixes always denied while AFK mode is on, comma-separated (e.g. 'npm run release, ./deploy.sh')

afkSpegniDopoMin.title: AFK: keep-awake idle timeout (minutes)
afkSpegniDopoMin.description: Minutes of inactivity (no turn, empty queue, no auto-resume wait) after which AFC stops keeping the PC awake
